name: 优光绒绒
habitat: 风铃岛野外随机刷新（中级以上咕噜球）
evolution: 优优 → 优光绒绒 / 绒光优优（Lv36 进化，最终形态）
description: 地系 T0 精灵（官方图鉴名：绒光优优，光/地系技能双修）。特性「哨兵」回合开始时若敌方技能足以击败自身，则速度 +50 并在行动后脱离，折返高频上下场掌控节奏；配合流沙 / 摇篮曲控场、硬化 + 放晴强化双防与输出，控场、增益、输出三位一体。
descriptionEn: A Ground-type T0 Jinie (officially "Rongguang Youyou") blending Light and Ground skills. Its "Sentinel" trait grants +50 SPD and a post-action pivot when an enemy move would KO it at turn start — enabling tempo-controlling switch-ins. With Quicksand / Lullaby control plus Harden and Clear Sky boosts, it covers control, buffing, and damage in one.
